svg.text: OXYGEN · SCENE GENERATION · SG.4 · DEVICE-ANCHORED CONCEPT BOARD
Add precipitation inside the installed forecast scene.
Real Pixel 3 XL capture anchors the current layout; the adjacent rain and snow sketches are proposed additions.
KEEP THE INSTALLED SCREEN'S READING ORDER
Precipitation begins below visible source clouds; data stays on top.
RAIN uses full sky cloud cover. Snow falls beneath a visible cloud bank.
Temperature and forecast data stay on top; the timeline remains the only time authority.
The Pixel capture is unchanged. Proposed precipitation is below its clouds; forecast text stays above.
PROPOSED SCENE-LAYER TREATMENTS · NOT DEVICE CAPTURES
RAIN · full cloud cover; drops begin beneath the clouds.
SNOW · varied flakes fall beneath the cloud bank.
DATA RULES THAT MUST SURVIVE EACH SCENE
Keep CLEAR / PARTLY_CLOUDY / CLOUDY labels. An interior gap carries the prior supplied display.
Zero chance/amount alone is insufficient. Reduced motion holds the scene; text facts remain readable.
